plan: A duo of hunters who make an area invincible for a moment and grow stronger by hunting.
aSurveiller: Their R (Lamb's Respite). Nobody can die in the zone for a moment: don't use your big spells inside it.
contrer: Wait for their R to end: nobody dies in the zone.
Engage once their Q is used: it's their only dash.
Protect your jungle camps: they gain stacks by hunting them.

sorts.P: Gains power by hunting their marks.
sorts.R: Nobody can die in the zone.

momentFort: Weak in duels early: they farm and hunt their marks. Invade them and steal the marks: they become fearsome over time.
